itemized.notes: 6-page filing: p1 cover (Dan Snarr, County Council #3, Interim/October 28 report), p2 Summary Page, p3 on-form Schedule A blank + handwritten 'See Attached', p4 landscape contributions attachment (handwritten header 'Contributions'), p5 on-form Schedule B blank + 'See Attached', p6 landscape expenditures attachment (handwritten header 'Expenditures'). The contributions attachment has columns Date | Name | Address | Occupation & Employer | Amount | In-Kind? - there is NO city or state column anywhere, and the Address column is a solid county redaction bar, so donor_city/donor_state are blank for every row (recorded as 'redacted'). One row carries 'LOAN' in the In-Kind? column (Dan Snarr $2,000.00) - a loan, not an in-kind contribution, so in_kind=false with the marker noted. Three expenditure rows name a recipient CLIPPED by the spreadsheet column ('Utah Democratic Par') - kept verbatim, never completed.
